## A - Exam authority, Section Ten Backing and Parking

This dossier supports first-time never-licensed applicants preparing for the regular passenger-car written knowledge test in Virginia. The issuing authority is the Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles. Handbook facts in this section come from the Virginia Driver's Manual pages on backing, parking, visibility, lights, hazardous conditions, and aggressive driving, covering reverse lookout, curb and hill parking, parking bans and distances, scanning craft, headlight laws, night, fog, rain, and snow response, and the aggressive-driving statute with its penalty. The official question count, test format, and time limit are not stated on the assigned pages, so this dossier asserts no value for any of them. Every threshold and distance in these pages lives as a cited knowledge fact in part C, not as exam-meta values here. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy.
